issues.title: Intake Link the Related Consumables field on Incident to the Consumable related item
issues.description:
Link the Related Consumables field on Incident to the Consumable related item. Currently, the user can add a cable in the Related Consumables field and at the same time create a record in the Consumable related item table. The two records are storing independent information, thus it may appear that two consumable cables were used.

Need to redesign so that when the Related Consumables field on Incident is populated, it will create the Consumable related item record. Users can populate the Quantity value on the Consumable related item record.

issues.title: Intake Add Multiple Consumable Items of Same Type
issues.description:
Related Consumables – Is it possible to add two of the same cable? Currently no. Need to add a way to capture the quantify of cables used as they are expensive. 

Add Multiple Consumable Items of Same Type. Currently there is the ability to add Multiple Consumable Items to the same incident as long as they are of different types. Need a way to track multiple consumables of the same type on an incident. The suggestion was to add a Consumable Quantity field on Incident which would be used to track the quantity of consumable. For example, if consumable model 'Cable 1' was related to the Incident and five of those cables were used, the 'Consumable Quantity' field would store the value 5.
